properties.name: Arcadia Planitia Base Alpha
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Near-surface massive sheet ice (<1m regolith overburden) and exceptionally flat terrain (<2° slope) for heavy cargo landing
properties.missionArchitecture: ISRU Water Extraction & Starship Propellant Production Hub
properties.description: Premier candidate for first crewed Starship landings. Abundant sheet ice confirmed by SWIM radar within 1 meter of the smooth, low-hazard volcanic plain.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering

properties.name: Deuteronilus Mensae Glacial Outpost
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Thick lobate debris apron (LDA) pure water ice glaciers protected by cliff escarpments offering passive galactic cosmic radiation shielding
properties.missionArchitecture: Subsurface Glacial Tunnelling & Deep Science Outpost
properties.description: Glacial bastion containing massive debris-covered glaciers hundreds of meters thick. Towering mesa cliffs provide natural shielding against cosmic rays and solar particle events.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering

properties.name: Mawrth Vallis Astrobiology Base
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Exposed stratigraphy of smectite and phyllosilicate clay strata for ISRU brick sintering and ancient astrobiology biosignature exploration
properties.missionArchitecture: Astrobiology Science Headquarters & Ceramic Regolith Manufacturing Facility
properties.description: One of the oldest ancient outflow channels on Mars, exposing rich, multi-layered phyllosilicate clay deposits ideal for mineral extraction, structural ceramic manufacturing, and searching for past life.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering

properties.name: Erebus Montes Shielded Outpost
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Subterranean lava tube voids and mass-wasting cliff shelter providing natural cosmic ray and micrometeorite shielding
properties.description: Rugged terrain with intact volcanic lava tubes and overhang structures, enabling expandable subterranean habitats that protect long-duration astronaut crews from radiation without heavy surface shielding mass.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering

properties.name: Melas Chasma Atmospheric Station
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Deep Valles Marineris canyon floor depression with elevated atmospheric pressure (~950 Pa), maximizing EDL aerocapture margins and aerodynamic radiation buffer
properties.missionArchitecture: Deep Canyon Atmospheric Research Station & Hydrated Mineral Refinery
properties.description: Situated at the deepest floor of central Valles Marineris, where atmospheric pressure reaches Mars peak (~950 Pa), substantially improving Entry, Descent, and Landing (EDL) performance and aerodynamic protection.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering

properties.name: Utopia Planitia Subsurface Vault
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Vast subsurface dielectric ice reservoir verified by Tianwen-1/Zhurong radar and SHARAD orbital sounding
properties.missionArchitecture: Cryo-Vault Storage, Industrial Deep Mining & Permanent Plains Habitat
properties.description: Broad northern lowland basin containing an enormous subsurface water ice sheet estimated to rival Lake Superior in volume, confirmed by Zhurong ground radar and MRO SHARAD observations.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering

properties.name: Jezero Delta Field Station
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Access to Mars 2020 Perseverance hermetic sample cache depot and well-characterized Neretva delta fan geology
properties.missionArchitecture: Sample Return Logistic Depot & Lacustrine Astrobiology Habitat
properties.description: Established around the high-priority sample return zone in Jezero Crater, utilizing years of rover traversal data and cataloged sample tubes sealed by NASA Mars 2020.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering

properties.name: Gale Oasis Base
properties.primarySuitabilityFactor: Stratigraphic ramp access to Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons) strata recording billions of years of Martian climate and geochemical transition
properties.missionArchitecture: Cross-Planetary Exploration Hub & Deep Stratigraphic Research Campus
properties.description: Located on the smooth northern floor of Gale Crater near Bradbury Landing, offering access to Mount Sharps 5-kilometer geological column and well-mapped Curiosity rover exploration routes.
properties.authority: NASA HLS2 / SpaceX / USGS Astrogeology / ARES Planetary Engineering
